question: Does the frozen epitope TopK2 sparse-edge idea transfer to paratope and pair-contact readouts?

readouts.paratope_topk2_edge_only: TopK2 mean pair probability over valid antigen partners for each antibody residue, transformed to a clipped logit
readouts.paratope_node_plus_topk2: Frozen paratope node logit plus the paratope TopK2 edge-only logit
readouts.contact_topk2_context_equal_logit: For each valid pair, equal-logit mean of the original pair logit, its antibody-row TopK2 logit, and its antigen-column TopK2 logit; pair indices and candidate mask are preserved

metrics.paired_interval: 10000-draw percentile bootstrap over 549 validation complexes, seed 20260828

decision_rule: This fixed-checkpoint control can establish transfer, neutrality, or a negative result. It cannot select a final model or establish generalization. Strict retraining is justified only if a non-epitope readout has positive mean-per-complex AP delta and a paired 95% interval excluding zero.
